summary: Implemented bounded memory-only recovery for author-owned post edit rejection. The single pre-fix RED failed all three focused tests as expected; the focused post-fix command passed 3/3, and the controller/community source suite passed 86/86 with zero skips or failures.

source.worktree_note: Only the three listed source/test paths are modified; pre-existing untracked hh-cycle13/ and hh-cycle15/ remain untouched. No staged changes.

change.flow: The unchanged app submit handler validates and builds the form payload, then dispatches forum-edit-post. The controller calls the existing community.updatePost with existing teacher/persona authority. When the current teacher editor receives title_and_body_required or input_too_long, it retains a bounded in-memory {postId,title,content} draft. Missing fields use saved values. Title/body overlength values retain one over-limit sentinel after safe normalization, so the retry remains invalid until corrected. The community renderer projects the draft only for the matching author-owned teacher post. Success clears it; cancel, a different edit/thread, role exit/logout, forum reset, and app reset clear post edit state.
change.boundaries: No app, service authority/limits, storage-port, persistence-format, backend/account, network, or dependency changes. Existing foreign-author controls and moderator controls remain unchanged. Reply edit recovery was not changed.

red.summary: Three tests failed on expected persisted-value rerender/draft-absence assertions; stderr empty; one RED run only.

review_crosscheck.finding: No contradiction: H2 independently reproduced the same post edit loss and confirmed save/cancel and owner/foreign controls. H2 also observed a separate rejected reply edit reprojection; reply edit recovery remains outside this E2903 scope/proposal.

evidence_limits: The first assertion in each focused RED test failed before later assertions executed; correction-write count, cancel restoration, thread isolation, padded overlength sentinels, and role/logout/reset cleanup are first-GREEN-only evidence, not claimed as individually demonstrated RED. The focused 3/3 and source-suite 86/86 runs passed. No canonical full build, browser QA, native receipt write, stage, or commit was performed.
